note: NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE.md has duplicate R-numbers (two R28/R32/R33/R42/R43/R44). Classified by heading. SEMANTIC_CLASS = a TTSR/rule candidate that cleared (or would clear) numeric bars and was refused on meaning. ARITHMETIC_CLASS = refused on hits/rate/FP/concentration/wallpaper. NOT_A_CLASS = instrument error, design rejection, omp fact, filing withdraw — not a rule-class to triage.

semantic_class.why: file-path claims; one ls is sufficient
correct bash unless pipefail, which the command string cannot see
triple-backtick fence extraction, the fleet's own idiom
clears bars; fires on meta-talk about workarounds

arithmetic_class.why: wallpaper; also precondition-not-defect but rate already refuses
FP and concentration; listed as semantic in the challenge but the bars already refuse

R54_note: WITHDRAW of a cass filing because the claimed defect did not reproduce. Semantic in the sense 'the bug isn't real', but it is not a TTSR class with hits/rate. Excluded from hybrid scoring.
honest_share: 6 semantic TTSR classes, not 'a large share of 55 R-numbers'. Most R-rows are instrument/design facts.
